jobs.description:
Job Description

You will be working on a flexible hybrid schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.

The work location for this role is 483 Bay Street in Toronto until approximately late 2026, when the work location will change to the new Mississauga office at 3 Robert Speck Parkway.

Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.

Who We Are

At Fidelity, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.

Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.

How You’ll Make An Impact

The Director, IS Transfer Agency and Workflow Systems Development is accountable for the development, modernization, and support of Fidelity Investment Canada Transfer Agency systems (AXIS, NEXUS) and supporting workflow applications.

The successful candidate is a forward-looking technology leader who can articulate and execute leading edge technology solutions, including the practical application of artificial intelligence, to enhance business outcomes and client servicing capabilities.

They are an enterprise thinker with the ability to lead effectively at both strategic and tactical levels, embedding strong engineering practices, disciplined delivery execution, and cybersecurity awareness into how teams operate day to day.

They will leverage their extensive industry and leadership experience to

Lead group of managers and scrum teams responsible for development
Manage department budgets, resourcing capacity and vendor relationships
Create department strategic plans, technology and process improvement roadmaps and oversees the progress.
Incorporate AI, automation, and emerging technologies into strategic roadmaps and execution plans to improve efficiency, scalability, and decision-making
Participate in IS division strategic planning and implementation of new technologies and modern solutions, working closely with Information Systems Directors & Managers and Business Partners to align technology services with business goals.
Ensure adoption of modern engineering practices (e.g., automation, DevOps, secure-by-design) across teams
Oversee and lead continuous improvements of teams’ development and production support processes, and tracks the adherence to defined KPIs and department, IS and organizational goals
Maintain diligent oversight of project advancements, team’s responses to production incidents and expedited requests, and leads his/her teams in excellent communication with all parties

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent working experience
10+ years in an operational role with experience in Transfer Agency and/or Workflows
5+ years in a leadership role within IT or equivalent role in Operations
Experience working within the mutual fund industry is a strong asset
Experience working with FundServ is an asset

Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills.
Strong management, interpersonal and diplomatic skills required to communicate with senior management across the organization.
Excellent Financial industry knowledge, especially for Transfer Agency services
Proven knowledge of the development methodology with practical experience in the development life cycle.
Strong understanding of modern engineering practices, including automation, DevOps, and inclusion of AI in the SDLC.
Demonstrated team leadership skills
Strategic planning skills and the ability to influence others.
Ability to balance innovation with execution discipline, ensuring new technologies are delivered in a controlled, scalable, and business-aligned manner.

jobs.description:

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As VP of Digital Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

--

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

What will your typical day look like?

Deloitte Global is seeking an experienced technology leader to lead the strategy, architecture, delivery, and continued evolution of our enterprise Salesforce platform and solutions.

As the Director, Salesforce Delivery & Architecture
, you will set the technical and delivery direction for Salesforce, translate business priorities into a scalable platform roadmap, and lead global teams across architecture, engineering, delivery, and operations. You will partner closely with senior business, product, and technology leaders and serve as a trusted advisor on platform strategy, investment, innovation, and execution.

This role combines Salesforce platform leadership, enterprise architecture, global delivery, governance, and technology strategy
and is ideal for a leader who can connect technical decisions to measurable business outcomes.

Work You'll Do

Define and lead the Salesforce platform strategy, architecture, and multi-year technology roadmap, aligning investments and capabilities with business and technology priorities.
Provide technical and delivery leadership across Salesforce solutions, integrations, and related enterprise platforms.
Lead global delivery teams through solution architecture, engineering, implementation, release, operations, and continuous improvement.
Establish architecture principles, engineering standards, and technical decision-making practices that enable scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions.
Partner with business sponsors, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to translate business priorities into platform capabilities and delivery plans.
Lead demand management, prioritization, and roadmap decisions across the Salesforce portfolio.
Provide leadership for major Salesforce implementations, enhancements, modernization efforts, and platform lifecycle initiatives.
Guide integration strategy across Salesforce and enterprise applications, including APIs, middleware, data platforms, and cloud services.
Champion Agile delivery, DevOps, and CI/CD practices to improve delivery speed, platform quality, reliability, and performance.
Evaluate emerging Salesforce capabilities, including Agentforce and AI-enabled solutions, and identify opportunities to apply them responsibly to business needs.
Define and track KPIs that measure platform performance, delivery outcomes, investment value, and value realization.
Lead technology budgeting, forecasting, resource planning, vendor management, and strategic technology partnerships.
Identify and manage technical, operational, financial, and delivery risks and ensure appropriate governance and mitigation plans are maintained.
Build trusted-advisor relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders while fostering collaboration across global teams.

Coach and develop technology leaders and promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaborartion, and continuous improvement.

About The Team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Required

Enough about us, let’s talk about you

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
15+ years of progressive technology experience, including significant leadership responsibility for enterprise technology platforms, applications, or solutions.
8+ years of Salesforce platform, architecture, or delivery experience, including leadership of complex enterprise implementations or transformation programs.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale technology initiatives from strategy and architecture through implementation and ongoing operations.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, integration patterns, APIs, data architecture, and modern application delivery.
Experience working with business sponsors, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
Experience leading globally distributed teams and working effectively across employees, contractors, vendors, and strategic technology partners.
Strong knowledge of Agile delivery and contemporary software development lifecycle practices.
Demonstrated experience with financial management, technology investment planning, vendor management, and resource planning.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business decisions.

Preferred

Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or other enterprise Salesforce products.
Experience with MuleSoft or comparable enterprise integration technologies.
Experience with modern Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD practices.
Knowledge of Salesforce Agentforce, AI-enabled Salesforce capabilities, or enterprise AI integration.
Salesforce architecture or advanced platform certification(s).
Experience supporting a large, complex, global enterprise.
Experience within professional services or financial services.
Experience establishing enterprise architecture standards, platform governance, and long-term technology roadmaps.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $140,000 - $260,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.

jobs.title: Director, Product Innovation
jobs.description:
HSB Canada, part of Munich Re, is Canada's premier engineering-driven specialty insurer and provider of inspection, engineering and technology services that set the standard for excellence in the market. Our constantly evolving offerings lead the market in cyber, equipment breakdown, renewable energy, technology services, engineering based risk management and inspection services. We bring technical expertise to help our clients stay ahead of complex, emerging and technology-based risks. We dare to think big and we are continuously innovating on behalf of our clients. We recognize Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging as key priorities and a culture that welcomes different thoughts and opinions.

HSB is much more! It’s insurance. Engineering. Technology. To learn more about us, please visit www.hsb.ca

Primary Objectives

Director, Product Innovation acts as a strategic catalyst and internal innovation & strategy consultant—turning market signals, data, and emerging risks into new insurance products/coverages and tech-enabled risk solutions/services for Canada. This leadership position carries enterprise-wide responsibilities and direct visibility to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, with work that significantly influences the organization’s growth and innovation agenda.

This role reports to the VP, Strategy & Innovation and sits within the Senior Leadership Team, with high visibility to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, and will have 1–2 direct reports (Product Innovation Strategists. This role will be integral in shaping our bold 2030 ambition by accelerating innovation outcomes, strengthening innovation governance, and launching 1–2 new products to market.

Job Responsibilities

Enterprise product innovation strategy & pipeline
Build and maintain an enterprise innovation roadmap across multiple lines, translating strategy into a prioritized portfolio of product and service opportunities.
Lead structured market and customer discovery—synthesizing broker/customer insights, competitor intelligence, market research, and emerging risk trends into clear product hypotheses and recommendations.
Develop executive-ready business cases and investment recommendations, managing research and insights budget.
IoT Solution Strategy
Define the IoT solution strategy for Canada: priority use-cases, target segments, value proposition, required data/telemetry, and partner ecosystem.
Shape bundled offerings that combine insurance with technology and value-add services (prevention, monitoring, response), in line with HSB’s broader IoT and technology-enabled risk approach.
Incubation Operating Model
Run a hypothesis-driven “test & learn” approach—designing low-risk experiments to validate desirability, viability, and feasibility before scaling.
Build and own a repeatable incubation playbook (problem framing → customer discovery → prototype/P&L → underwriting/claims/legal review → pilot → launch), reinforcing speed with discipline.
Innovation Governance & Decision Velocity
Steward and continuously improve the established innovation governance process—intake criteria, prioritization, stage gates, and transparent decision documentation—to drive throughput and quality.
Establish meaningful metrics and dashboards for pipeline health, launch progress, and measurable outcomes.
End-to-End Product Launch
Lead cross-functional delivery of 1–2 new products per year from concept to launch: coverage design/wording, underwriting appetite, pricing approach, operational readiness, and go-to-market enablement. Define product KPIs and performance monitoring plans and translate insights into iteration post-launch.
Product Mechanics: Rigor & Credibility
Partner with Underwriting, Actuarial, Claims, Legal/Compliance, and Technology to ensure new and evolving products are implementable, governed, and aligned with underwriting intent and risk appetite.
Bring structured thinking to profitability and sustainability—supporting segmentation, rate adequacy discussions, and portfolio insights as needed.
Executive Advisory & Stakeholder Influence
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders—framing decisions, facilitating alignment, and telling a clear story from data to recommendation. Manage complex senior stakeholder dynamics across the business and with global partners, ensuring strong alignment and decision velocity.
Leading, coaching, and developing team of Product Innovation Strategists
Establishing team operating rhythms and removing delivery blockers

Qualifications

University-level education in finance, business administration, economics, risk management, or equivalent professional experience; MBA or equivalent graduate degree an asset
8–12 years demonstrated experience in strategy, innovation, or product roles; insurance or broader financial services
Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving: ability to frame ambiguity, develop options, assess trade-offs, and drive to clear decisions.
Strong analytical capability: extracting insights from data and market research and translate them into strategy and action.
Multi-workstream leadership: proven ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel while maintaining quality, pace, and stakeholder alignment.
People leadership experience (formal or informal): ability to coach talent, delegate effectively, and drive accountability in a small, high-performing team.
Executive communication: ability to produce crisp, compelling materials and present complex topics simply and persuasively to senior audiences.
Strong P&C insurance (or broader financial services) product knowledge—coverage/wordings, underwriting appetite, pricing fundamentals, and regulatory considerations is an asset
Prior strategy consulting experience (e.g., strategy consulting Engagement Manager/Senior Manager level) or equivalent internal strategy/innovation consulting experience is an asset
Experience building ecosystems/partnerships (vendors, data providers, technology partners) to enable product and service innovation is an asset

Company Benefits

Together, we engage with everything we have and are, to help humankind act braver and better. Go further with HSB.

We are pleased to offer our employees great benefits and resources to support their mental, physical and financial wellbeing. These Include:

An engaging and collaborative environment that promotes continuous learning and development
A hybrid work environment that combines weekly in-office and remote days
A great compensation package including an annual company bonus
Competitive company-paid flexible health and dental benefits, starting on your first day
Flexible dollars provided by the company to put towards a Health Spending Account and/or Wellness Spending Account
Wellness program with tools and resources supporting your mental, physical, and financial wellbeing – on and off the job
Participation in the DC Pension Plan with a progressive employer contribution scale based on tenure starting at 4%, plus optional company match in the RRSP plan
Generous time off including vacation, personal days, unplanned time, Statutory Holidays and company-wide early closure half-days
Learning and development programs and resources, including unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, Education Assistance Program, and reimbursement for professional fees
Employee Referral Program and Recognition Program

Our base salary range for this role is between $145170 and $169365 per year , plus an opportunity for an annual company bonus based upon a percentage of eligible pay. The salary estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for candidates hired in this position. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to internal equity.

This role is located in our Toronto office on 390 Bay St, and we operate in a hybrid work model. This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

We do not use AI in our recruitment process - applications are reviewed by our team to ensure a fair and personalized experience.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however only those selected for interview will be contacted.

jobs.description:
A career as an Associate Director or Director, Business Integrator on the New Products and Activities team at National Bank of Canada Capital Markets means acting as a strategic partner in delivering new products and business initiatives. In this role, you leverage your expertise in securities trading and financing to lead the assessment and integration of complex, high-impact initiatives by influencing key operating model design decisions, risk frameworks and integration strategies. This job allows you to have a direct impact on the organization by enabling business growth while ensuring strong operational, regulatory, and risk frameworks.

Your Job

Lead the assessment and integration of new securities trading and financing products and activities, including contributing to the definition of end-to-end operational, regulatory, and risk requirements.

Develop a strong understanding of trading structures, financing transactions, and business objectives to challenge assumptions, ensure robustness of solutions and influence decision-making.

Contribute to the definition of target-state operating models and provide strategic recommendations that support scalable and sustainable growth.
Apply an enterprise-wide lens to balance business objectives, operational efficiency, risk management, and regulatory requirements, while influencing partners and stakeholders to align on strategic direction and to deliver scalable, long-term solutions.
Drive alignment and collaboration across end-to-end key stakeholders; Operations, Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, Treasury, and other.

Establish and maintain robust governance, controls, implementation plans, and deployment strategies while proactively identifying and resolving risks and issues while escalating material concerns to senior stakeholders and governance committees.

Your Team

This position reports to the Managing Director responsible for transformation and evolution initiatives in the New Products and Activities team within the Capital Markets sector. Our team consists of around 45 highly experienced, talented, and dedicated individuals and stands out for its strong collaboration, agility, and deep understanding of capital markets activities and operating models.

You will work closely with trading, risk management, and functional experts across the organization, gaining end-to-end exposure to products, processes, and business strategies. We foster a dynamic environment where learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing are encouraged.

Our training approach is based on hands-on experience and exposure to complex initiatives. You will benefit from continuous learning opportunities, access to subject matter experts, and the chance to develop a broad perspective on capital markets. Career growth opportunities include expanding into leadership roles or deepening expertise across asset classes, products, and transformation initiatives.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a related field with 7–10 years of relevant experience in Capital Markets

Strong understanding of securities trading and financing products (equities, fixed income, repos, securities lending, ETFs, structured products)

In-depth knowledge of front-to-back processes including trading, clearing, settlement, custody, collateral management, and reconciliations

Understanding of market infrastructures (clearing houses, custodians, central securities depositories, triparty agents, payment systems)

Extensive experience leading large-scale, cross-functional transformational initiatives in complex capital markets environments.

Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

 For the Toronto location only, proficiency in English is required. French is considered an asset, but it is not mandatory.
Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to work closely with our colleagues outside Quebec.
Required skills: Accountability, Capital Markets, Client-focused, Communication, Driving Results, Emotional Intelligence, Empathy, Humility, Influencing Skills, Initiative, Leadership, Learning Agility, Product Knowledge, Resilience, Teamwork

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment

We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls

Primary Objectives

Director, Product Innovation acts as a strategic catalyst and internal innovation & strategy consultant—turning market signals, data, and emerging risks into new insurance products/coverages and tech-enabled risk solutions/services for Canada. This leadership position carries enterprise-wide responsibilities and direct visibility to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, with work that significantly influences the organization’s growth and innovation agenda.

Job Responsibilities

Enterprise product innovation strategy & pipeline
Build and maintain an enterprise innovation roadmap across multiple lines, translating strategy into a prioritized portfolio of product and service opportunities.
Lead structured market and customer discovery—synthesizing broker/customer insights, competitor intelligence, market research, and emerging risk trends into clear product hypotheses and recommendations.
Develop executive-ready business cases and investment recommendations, managing research and insights budget.
IoT Solution Strategy
Define the IoT solution strategy for Canada: priority use-cases, target segments, value proposition, required data/telemetry, and partner ecosystem.
Shape bundled offerings that combine insurance with technology and value-add services (prevention, monitoring, response), in line with HSB’s broader IoT and technology-enabled risk approach.
Incubation Operating Model
Run a hypothesis-driven “test & learn” approach—designing low-risk experiments to validate desirability, viability, and feasibility before scaling.
Build and own a repeatable incubation playbook (problem framing → customer discovery → prototype/P&L → underwriting/claims/legal review → pilot → launch), reinforcing speed with discipline.

Experience building ecosystems/partnerships (vendors, data providers, technology partners) to enable product and service innovation is an asset

new_jobs.description:

Marketing
Full time
Remote (USA, Canada or South Africa)

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As VP of Performance Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

new_jobs.description:
A career as an Associate Director or Director, Business Integrator on the New Products and Activities team at National Bank of Canada Capital Markets means acting as a strategic partner in delivering new products and business initiatives. In this role, you leverage your expertise in securities trading and financing to lead the assessment and integration of complex, high-impact initiatives by influencing key operating model design decisions, risk frameworks and integration strategies. This job allows you to have a direct impact on the organization by enabling business growth while ensuring strong operational, regulatory, and risk frameworks.

Your Job

Lead the assessment and integration of new securities trading and financing products and activities, including contributing to the definition of end-to-end operational, regulatory, and risk requirements.

Develop a strong understanding of trading structures, financing transactions, and business objectives to challenge assumptions, ensure robustness of solutions and influence decision-making.

Contribute to the definition of target-state operating models and provide strategic recommendations that support scalable and sustainable growth.
Apply an enterprise-wide lens to balance business objectives, operational efficiency, risk management, and regulatory requirements, while influencing partners and stakeholders to align on strategic direction and to deliver scalable, long-term solutions.
Drive alignment and collaboration across end-to-end key stakeholders; Operations, Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, Treasury, and other.

Establish and maintain robust governance, controls, implementation plans, and deployment strategies while proactively identifying and resolving risks and issues while escalating material concerns to senior stakeholders and governance committees.

Your Team

This position reports to the Managing Director responsible for transformation and evolution initiatives in the New Products and Activities team within the Capital Markets sector. Our team consists of around 45 highly experienced, talented, and dedicated individuals and stands out for its strong collaboration, agility, and deep understanding of capital markets activities and operating models.

You will work closely with trading, risk management, and functional experts across the organization, gaining end-to-end exposure to products, processes, and business strategies. We foster a dynamic environment where learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing are encouraged.

Our training approach is based on hands-on experience and exposure to complex initiatives. You will benefit from continuous learning opportunities, access to subject matter experts, and the chance to develop a broad perspective on capital markets. Career growth opportunities include expanding into leadership roles or deepening expertise across asset classes, products, and transformation initiatives.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a related field with 7–10 years of relevant experience in Capital Markets

Strong understanding of securities trading and financing products (equities, fixed income, repos, securities lending, ETFs, structured products)

In-depth knowledge of front-to-back processes including trading, clearing, settlement, custody, collateral management, and reconciliations

Understanding of market infrastructures (clearing houses, custodians, central securities depositories, triparty agents, payment systems)

Extensive experience leading large-scale, cross-functional transformational initiatives in complex capital markets environments.

Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

 For the Toronto location only, proficiency in English is required. French is considered an asset, but it is not mandatory.
Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to work closely with our colleagues outside Quebec.
Required skills: Accountability, Capital Markets, Client-focused, Communication, Driving Results, Emotional Intelligence, Empathy, Humility, Influencing Skills, Initiative, Leadership, Learning Agility, Product Knowledge, Resilience, Teamwork

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment

We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?
